attempts.disposition: The native picker selection first appeared disabled because an accessibility click did not select the row. Typing the manifest name selected it; the existing UTI picker was retained unchanged.
The packaged Studio opened all three manifests. Antiky Town paused, stepped once, resumed, and published its generic inspection view.
The artifact test assumed ignored dist output already existed. The failing clean-check case now builds every artifact it inspects.
The Feedback 06 verifier and full repository check passed after the clean-test correction.
